name: R&D Expense Trajectory
construction: Slope of the linear regression of research and development (R&D) expenses over the past 8 quarters.
reason: Both use growth/trajectory of innovation expenses, but R&D vs advertising.

name: Share Repurchase Intensity
construction: Dollar value of shares repurchased over the past year divided by market capitalization, using Compustat and CRSP.
reason: Both use repurchases scaled by market cap.

name: R&D Expense Growth
construction: Year-over-year percentage change in research and development expenditure.
reason: Both measure growth in innovation-related expenses.

name: Salary Ratio
construction: Calculate the ratio of the CEO's salary to the median employee's salary.
reason: No library predictor uses CEO/employee salary ratio.

name: IP Portfolio Strength
construction: Measure of the size and quality of a firm's intellectual property portfolio, based on patent filings and citations.
reason: PatentsRD uses patent/citation data; similar to IP portfolio strength.

name: Accounts Payable Days Growth
construction: year-over-year change in accounts payable days, calculated using Compustat data on accounts payable and cost of goods sold over the past 5 years
reason: No library predictor uses change in payable days.

name: Working Capital Efficiency
construction: Ratio of current assets excluding cash to current liabilities
reason: Both relate to net operating assets and working capital efficiency.

name: CEO Tenure Change
construction: Identify changes in CEO tenure by comparing CEO names from the current and previous year's annual reports.
reason: No library predictor tracks CEO tenure or changes.

name: Cybersecurity Investments
construction: Estimate a company's investment in cybersecurity, based on job postings for cybersecurity roles and mentions in annual reports.
reason: No library predictor uses cybersecurity investment or job postings.

name: SupplierIndustryConcentration
construction: Herfindahl index of supplier industry concentration, calculated as the sum of squared percentages of sales to each supplier industry, over the past 3 years
reason: Both use Herfindahl index, but on supplier industries not assets.

name: Unrecognized Pension Liability Ratio
construction: Unrecognized pension liabilities divided by market capitalization, as disclosed in footnotes of annual reports.
reason: Both relate to pension liabilities, but not unrecognized portion.

name: Employee Turnover
construction: Number of employees leaving over a given period divided by the total number of employees
reason: No employee turnover or similar HR metric in library.

name: Customer Satisfaction Index
construction: Average customer satisfaction scores from independent surveys, normalized across all companies.
reason: No customer satisfaction or similar survey-based signal.

name: Supplier Concentration
construction: Calculate the Herfindahl index of supplier sales over the past year, using Compustat data.
reason: Both use Herfindahl index, but for assets vs. suppliers.

name: Accounts Payable Days Deceleration
construction: Calculate the difference in accounts payable days between the current year and the average of the past 3 years
reason: No library predictor uses accounts payable days or similar construction.

name: Return on Assets
construction: Calculate net income over total assets.
reason: Return on assets (net income/total assets) matches roaq.

name: Customer Concentration Exposure
construction: Percentage of sales to the largest customer (from 10-K disclosures) in the most recent fiscal year.
reason: No library predictor uses customer concentration as a signal.

name: Customer Concentration
construction: Total revenue from the firm's largest customer divided by total revenue, computed annually. Data from Thomson Reuters.
reason: Both measure concentration, but Herf is industry, not customer.

name: Sales Growth Deceleration
construction: difference between the average sales growth rate over the past 2 years and the average sales growth rate over the past 5 years
reason: No sales growth deceleration or similar in library.

name: Capex Efficiency
construction: Calculate as the change in capital expenditures divided by the change in total assets over the past year.
reason: Both use change in capex, but denominator differs.

name: Patent Count
construction: Count the total number of patents a company has applied for and received over the past year.
reason: Patent count is closely related to patents-to-R&D.

name: Option-Implied Volatility Slope
construction: Difference between implied volatilities of 3-month and 6-month at-the-money call options, using listed equity options data.
reason: Both use option-implied volatility slopes, but SmileSlope uses puts.

name: Cybersecurity Investment
construction: From annual reports and other filings, measure a firm's investment in cybersecurity infrastructure and personnel.
reason: No library predictor uses cybersecurity investment or related disclosures.

name: Social Media Sentiment Score
construction: Net positive mentions of the firm on major social media platforms over the past quarter, scaled by total mentions.
reason: No library predictor uses social media sentiment or similar data.

name: Gross Profitability
construction: Calculate the ratio of gross profits to total assets for the previous fiscal year.
reason: Gross profits to total assets matches GP signal.

name: Operating Cost Stickiness
construction: Measure percent change in operating costs when revenue falls by at least 5% year-over-year; define stickiness as % cost change divided by % revenue change.
reason: No library predictor measures cost stickiness or cost/revenue elasticity.

name: Employee Satisfaction
construction: Collect data from available firm-level surveys on employee satisfaction, normalize the scores, and calculate the percentile rank for each firm.
reason: No library predictor uses employee satisfaction survey data.

name: Customer Complaint Count
construction: Count the number of customer complaints received over the past quarter.
reason: No library predictor uses customer complaint data.

name: Customer Concentration
construction: Revenue from the top five customers divided by total revenue, averaged over the past three years.
reason: No library predictor uses customer concentration or revenue share.

name: Dividend Payout Ratio Volatility
construction: Calculate the standard deviation of the dividend payout ratio over the past 5 years
reason: No library predictor uses payout ratio volatility or similar construction.

name: R&D Intensity Change
construction: Change in R&D expenditure over the past year, scaled by beginning-of-year total assets. Data from Compustat: (R&D_t - R&D_{t-1}) / Assets_{t-1}.
reason: Both capture unexpected or changing R&D investment.

name: Patent Portfolio Value
construction: Number of patents held by the company multiplied by the average citation count per patent.
reason: Both use patent counts and citations as innovation proxies.

name: Insider Trading Ratio
construction: The ratio of insider purchases to insider sales over the past 6 months.
reason: No insider trading ratio or similar signal in library.

name: Inventory Growth Rate
construction: Year-over-year percentage change in inventories (from Compustat annual data: INVT) divided by prior-year total assets (AT).
reason: Inventory growth scaled by assets matches InvGrowth construction.

name: Website Traffic Growth
construction: Percentage growth in unique website visits over the past quarter, using third-party web analytics data.
reason: No library predictor uses website traffic or similar digital metrics.

name: Seasonal Sales Growth
construction: Percentage change in sales (Compustat item SALEQ) from the same fiscal quarter in the prior year.
reason: Both use revenue growth, but MeanRankRevGrowth is annual, not seasonal.

name: Environmental Violation Count
construction: Count the number of environmental violations reported against the company in the last five years.
reason: No library predictor based on environmental violations or similar ESG events.

name: Customer Concentration
construction: Revenue from the firm's largest customer divided by total revenue. Data source: annual Form 10-K disclosures.
reason: No customer concentration or similar variable in library.

name: Management Tenure
construction: Average tenure of the management team, derived from company reports.
reason: No library predictor uses management tenure or executive stability.

name: Debt Maturity
construction: Calculate as the average time until a company's debt comes due.
reason: No library predictor uses debt maturity or similar.
